summary: Task 4 iter186 — Subscription lifecycle handling. Backend: 14/14 pytest passed on /app/backend/tests/test_subscription_lifecycle_iter186.py. Covers all 5 lifecycle states (never_subscribed | active | cancelled_grace | expired | admin_bypass), self-cancel endpoint (grace-period access retention, idempotent on cancelled/expired, 404 when no subscription doc), regression on paid features (POST /house-health/documents and POST /digital-twin/projects → 402 for expired user), and data-integrity regression (GET /properties/{id}, /properties/{id}/documents, /properties/{id}/technical-record all 200 for expired user with existing property). Frontend: SubscriptionNotice banner renders correctly on /client for expired user (data-testid='subscription-notice-subscription_expired') with correct Romanian message and CTA that navigates to /pricing; dismiss button sets sessionStorage.pm_notice_dismissed=1 and hides banner; never_subscribed user sees NO banner (component returns null). Cleanup performed on test users matching ^(exp|lifecycle|free)\d+.*@example.com$ + orphan hh_subscriptions.
critical_code_review_comments: entitlements.py _fetch_active_subscription now accepts status='cancelled' in the active list — semantically correct: cancelled subscriptions retain access until expires_at. _compute_lifecycle correctly maps status=='cancelled' + future expiry → 'cancelled_grace'.

entitlements_api.py cancel_my_subscription: idempotent branch (line 42-44) returns snapshot when status not in {active,trial,grace} — verified test_cancel_idempotent_on_cancelled passes on both cancelled and expired states. No 500 leaks.

entitlements.py:198 uses (sub_last or {}).get('plan','').lower() — safe if plan is None (defaults to '' before .lower()), no AttributeError risk. Verified with test_expired_lifecycle_free_tier_with_notice.
SubscriptionNotice.jsx: sessionStorage read is guarded with try/catch (line 33) — safe against Safari private-mode. Dismiss also try/catch on write (line 48). Good defensive coding.
SubscriptionNotice.jsx returns null when entitlements.notice is null → correctly hides for never_subscribed/active/admin_bypass — verified in frontend test.

MINOR (non-blocking): cancel endpoint queries hh_subscriptions.find_one({user_id}) without ordering. If a user ever ended up with multiple docs (shouldn't happen — upsert on user_id), the first arbitrary one wins. Consider adding sort=[('updated_at',-1)] for defensive read.

MINOR (non-blocking): cancel endpoint at /me/subscription/cancel does not restrict role — admin/operator hitting it would 404 (no hh_subscriptions doc), which is acceptable but could return a friendlier 400 'not applicable for admin role'.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (banner render + CTA nav + dismiss + never_subscribed hidden all pass)
